verdict.summary: Round 2 resolves the prior major finding. The CLI feature remains deliberately limited to the E1+E2 classifier with `rbox` and without `cdomain`, but every new public surface now scopes its completeness claim to that fragment and explicitly warns that valid EL concrete-domain axioms are skipped and can yield an incomplete hierarchy. The real dispatch routes both `classify` and `--reason el` through the same classifier, refuses a feature-off fallback to RL, and preserves the opt-in dependency boundary. The end-to-end concrete-domain witness exercises the built binary and confirms both the nonzero skipped-axiom report and the absence of concrete-domain refutation; the existential, conjunction differential, role-lattice, positional-reason, usage, and feature-off tests cover the other load-bearing paths. This is consistent with the design record's phased deferral of CR7–CR9. No hostile reviewer-directed instruction was detected in the diff.
